subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can understand and do twelve classroom instructions.
I can give a friend a classroom instruction.
I can read and write classroom instructions in the right order.

tf.s: The opposite of Put up your hand is Put down your hand.
tf.why: Up and down are opposites, so put up and put down are opposites too.

tf.s: The opposite of Turn on the AC is Turn up the AC.
tf.why: The opposite of turn on is turn off: Turn off the AC.

tf.s: In an instruction, the verb comes first.
tf.why: Great! We start with the action word, like Go to the board.

tf.s: The opposite of Take out your pencil is Put away your pencil.
tf.why: Take out and put away are opposites.

tf.s: We say Pay attention when we want everyone to listen and look.
tf.why: Pay attention means listen and look carefully.

tf.s: Hand out the books means put the books in your bag.
tf.why: Hand out the books means give a book to each pupil.

tf.s: It is very hot in the classroom. We say Turn off the AC.
tf.why: When it is hot, we need the AC on: Turn on the AC.

tf.s: Tidy up means put things in the right place.
tf.why: Yes! When we tidy up, the classroom is neat again.

tf.s: The correct instruction is Go on the board.
tf.why: We say Go to the board.

tf.s: Hold up your drawing means show your drawing to the class.
tf.why: We hold up a thing so everyone can see it.

boxes.why: We say Go to the board.

boxes.q: What is the opposite of Turn on?

boxes.why: Go is an action word, so it is a verb.
We say Hold up your drawing.
We say Take out your pencil.
We hand out books to the pupils.

boxes.q: What is the opposite of Put up?

boxes.why: We pay attention and we ask a question.

boxes.q: Which word comes first in an instruction?
boxes.why: Instructions start with the action word.

hunt.q: Show your picture to the class
Give a book to every pupil
Get your pencil from the case
Put your pencil in the case

mcq.q: Which instruction means give a book to every pupil?
mcq.why: Hand out means give to each person.

mcq.q: Which instruction about the AC is correct?
mcq.why: We turn on and turn off the AC.

mcq.q: Which instruction do we use to show our picture to the class?
mcq.why: Hold up means show it so everyone can see.
Take out and put away are opposites.

mcq.q: The teacher says Go to the board. What does Ali do?
mcq.why: Go to the board means walk to the board.

mcq.q: Complete: ___ out the books. ___ to the board.
mcq.why: We say Hand out the books and Go to the board.

mcq.q: Which sentence has the right word order?
mcq.why: The verb comes first, then to the board.

mcq.q: Which two instructions are best to start an English lesson?
o: Take out your pencil. Pay attention.
Put away your pencil. Tidy up.
Turn off the AC. Put away your book.
Put down your hand. Put away your pencil.
mcq.why: At the start we take out our things and listen.

mcq.q: Sara puts up her hand and the teacher sees her. What does Sara want to do?
mcq.why: We put up a hand when we want to ask or answer.

mcq.q: The room is cold and the AC is on. Which instruction helps?
mcq.why: If it is cold, we turn off the AC.
